mcq.s: On which date was the formation of the first Interim National Government announced?
mcq.x: The Interim Government was announced on 24 August 1946 and took charge on 2 September 1946 with Nehru as Vice-President of the Executive Council.

mcq.s: Arrange the following in chronological order, earliest first: (I) Appointment of the Drafting Committee (II) Adoption and enactment of the Indian Constitution (III) Commencement of the Indian Constitution (IV) First meeting of the Constituent Assembly
mcq.x: First meeting 9 December 1946; Drafting Committee 29 August 1947; adopted 26 November 1949; commenced 26 January 1950.

mcq.s: The years of birth and death of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar are:
mcq.x: Ambedkar was born on 14 April 1891 at Mhow and died on 6 December 1956 in Delhi.

mcq.s: Match the provisions of the Indian Constitution with their sources: A. Fundamental Rights B. Directive Principles of State Policy C. Cabinet Government D. Union-State relations (strong Centre federation) — 1. British Constitution 2. Canadian Constitution 3. Irish Constitution 4. US Bill of Rights
mcq.x: Fundamental Rights come from the US Bill of Rights, DPSP from Ireland, Cabinet government from Britain and the federation with a strong Centre from Canada.

mcq.s: The Constitution of India at present consists of:
mcq.x: The original 395 Articles have grown through amendments (added as 21A, 243A etc.) to more than 450 Articles today, with 12 Schedules.

mcq.s: Match: A. Formation of new States B. Citizenship C. Fundamental Rights D. Setting up of Administrative Tribunals — 1. Part II 2. Article 3 3. Article 323-A 4. Part III
mcq.x: New States: Article 3; Citizenship: Part II; Fundamental Rights: Part III; Administrative Tribunals: Article 323-A.

why: answer key wrong (390 Articles, 5 Schedules is not correct)
answer mixes original (395 Articles, 22 Parts) and present (12 Schedules) counts

mcq.s: Match: A. Impeachment of the President B. Removal of the Vice-President C. Removal of the Speaker of Lok Sabha D. Removal of the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha — 1. Article 90 2. Article 61 3. Article 94 4. Article 67(b)
mcq.x: Article 61: impeachment of the President; 67(b): removal of the Vice-President; 94: removal of the Speaker; 90: removal of the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

mcq.s: Match: A. Admission of new States by law B. Right to equality C. Protection against arrest and detention D. Power of the President to assent to Bills — 1. Article 14 2. Article 2 3. Article 111 4. Article 22
mcq.x: Article 2: admission of new States; Article 14: equality; Article 22: protection against arrest and detention; Article 111: assent to Bills.

mcq.s: Match: A. Consolidated Fund of India B. Finance Commission C. Financial Emergency D. Comptroller and Auditor General of India — 1. Article 266 2. Article 360 3. Article 280 4. Article 148
mcq.x: Consolidated Fund: Article 266; Finance Commission: Article 280; Financial Emergency: Article 360; CAG: Article 148.
